name: Ina & Danny Wangerin
description: Mother Ina from Germany, father Danny a veteran. Mennonite family from North Lawrence. Quickly became close with the Meyers family after arriving at CFC in late 2014 — Thanksgiving together from that year forward. Their eight children formed a significant portion of JD's mid-2010s social world.

events.detail: Ceremony at CFC Potsdam; Ina made the wedding cake.
